def: something sown (only in the plural), i.e. a vegetable (as food)

occurrences.text: Prove thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat, and water to drink.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
